title: Full-ball kernel bound from ball growth (Simon 4.10(2), σ = 0, via 4.11)
statement: Let X be a normed additive group with its Borel σ-algebra, μ a measure on X, n ≥ 1 an integer, y ∈ X and ρ, K ∈ ℝ. Assume μ(B_s(y)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(K sⁿ) for every 0 < s ≤ ρ (closed balls). Then for every 0 < s ≤ ρ, ∫_{B_s(y)} ENNReal.ofReal(‖x − y‖^{1−n}) dμ(x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(n K s) (lower Lebesgue integral; ‖x − y‖^{1−n} is the real power, which at x = y equals 1 if n = 1 and 0 if n ≥ 2).
lean_statement: ∀ {X : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (n : ℕ) (y : X) (ρ K : ℝ), 0 < n → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ → μ (closedBall y s) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K * s ^ n)) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ → ∫⁻ x in closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (‖x - y‖ ^ (1 - (n : ℝ))) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (n * K * s)
